question: Which Large Corporate clients with more than $25 million of active commitments have had no contact from any banker in the last 90 days?
answer:
**12 of the 38 Large Corporate clients with more than $25M of active commitments have had no banker contact in the last 90 days.** Together they hold **$352.2M** of active commitments. All 12 are well past the 90-day mark: the most recent contact among them was 136 days ago, and the oldest was 242 days ago. No client fell near the cutoff, so the list doesn't change if the window shifts by a few days.

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

| 12 | 0000041037 | Brightwater Manufacturing LLC | Sawyer Rourke, RM004 (C&I East) | 2 | $25.8M | 2026-03-14 (RM) | 200 |

**Where the gaps are:** 9 of the 12 clients sit with C&I East, including 2 each for Gray Lowry, Jordan Thorne, Sage Garrow and Sawyer Rourke. Dana Abbott (C&I Central) also has 2. Every one of these clients has been contacted at some point in the CRM history, which starts 2025-08-26, so these are lapsed relationships rather than clients no one has ever called.

**Sources and definitions**
- **Large Corporate:** clients coded `SEGMENT_CD = 'LC'` in `BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT`, confirmed against `REF.SEGMENT`. All clients in the master are active.
- **Active commitments:** the total committed amount across each client's facilities with status ACTIVE in `LENDING.FACILITY`. Paid-off and charged-off facilities are excluded. A client qualifies only if this total is strictly above $25M, so the 2 Large Corporate clients at exactly $25.0M are excluded. Both had recent contact anyway.
- **Contact from any banker:** any entry in `CORE.RM_CONTACT` by either a relationship manager or a treasury management officer, through any channel (call, email, meeting or site visit). I counted a client as uncontacted if it had no entry after 2026-07-02, which is 90 days before the 2026-09-30 data date.
- **RM and team:** the client's assigned RM in `CORE.CLIENT`, looked up in `CORE.RM_ROSTER`.

**Assumptions and data notes**
- 1,071 facilities are still marked ACTIVE although their maturity date has passed. They all appear in the September 2026 month-end balances, so I treated them as live, most likely extended or renewed. Check whether the maturity dates on those facilities need updating.
- I didn't use the risk and capital-markets data in Fabric, because the question is only about this bank's clients, commitments and contact history. I didn't use any sandbox or financial-crime tables either.

sql.sql:
select 'seg' k, segment_cd v, count(*) n from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT group by 2
union all select 'status', client_status, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT group by 2
union all select 'cif_len', length(cif_no)::text, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT group by 2
union all select 'fac_status', facility_status, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY group by 2
union all select 'fac_cif_len', length(cif_no)::text, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY group by 2
union all select 'role', banker_role, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT group by 2
union all select 'channel', channel, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT group by 2
union all select 'ct_cif_len', length(cif_no)::text, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT group by 2
order by 1,2

select
 (select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY where facility_status='ACTIVE' and (payoff_dt is not null or chgoff_dt is not null)) active_w_close_dt,
 (select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY where facility_status='ACTIVE' and maturity_dt < '2026-09-30') active_matured,
 (select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY where commit_amt is null or commit_amt<=0) bad_commit,
 (select max(contact_dt) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT) max_ct,
 (select min(contact_dt) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT) min_ct,
 (select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT where contact_dt > '2026-09-30') future_ct,
 (select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT where cif_no not in (select cif_no from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT)) orphan_ct,
 (select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY where cif_no not in (select cif_no from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT)) orphan_fac,
 (select count(*) - count(distinct cif_no) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT) dup_cif

select f.facility_status, (b.facility_id is not null) in_sep_snap, (f.maturity_dt < '2026-09-30') matured, count(*) n, sum(commit_amt) commit
from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f
left join BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b on b.facility_id=f.facility_id and b.snap_dt='2026-09-30'
group by 1,2,3 order by 1,2,3

with fac as (
  select cif_no, count(*) n_fac, sum(commit_amt) active_commit
  from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY where facility_status='ACTIVE' group by 1),
ct as (
  select cif_no, max(contact_dt) last_contact,
         max(case when banker_role='RM' then contact_dt end) last_rm,
         max(case when banker_role='TM_OFFICER' then contact_dt end) last_tm,
         count_if(contact_dt > dateadd(day,-90,'2026-09-30'::date)) ct_90d
  from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT group by 1)
select c.cif_no, c.client_nm, c.rm_id, r.rm_nm, r.team, f.n_fac, f.active_commit,
       ct.last_contact, ct.last_rm, ct.last_tm, datediff(day, ct.last_contact, '2026-09-30'::date) days_since, coalesce(ct.ct_90d,0) ct_90d
from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c
join fac f on f.cif_no=c.cif_no
left join ct on ct.cif_no=c.cif_no
left join BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER r on r.rm_id=c.rm_id
where c.segment_cd='LC' and c.client_status='ACTIVE' and f.active_commit > 25000000
  and (ct.last_contact is null or ct.last_contact <= dateadd(day,-80,'2026-09-30'::date))
order by f.active_commit desc

with fac as (select cif_no, sum(commit_amt) ac from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY where facility_status='ACTIVE' group by 1),
ct as (select cif_no, max(contact_dt) lc from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT group by 1)
select count_if(f.ac>25000000) n_gt25, count_if(f.ac=25000000) n_eq25,
 count_if(f.ac=25000000 and (ct.lc is null or ct.lc <= dateadd(day,-90,'2026-09-30'::date))) eq25_nocontact,
 count_if(f.ac>25000000 and ct.lc is null) never_contacted
from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c join fac f on f.cif_no=c.cif_no left join ct on ct.cif_no=c.cif_no
where c.segment_cd='LC'
